resources.string: Choose a GPX 1.1 file, review its routes, then select the routes to keep in your private library. Importing a route does not create a workout.
No file selected. Files from supported document providers can be read offline when available locally.
Found %1$d routes · %2$d valid. Select one or more valid routes.
%1$d routes saved and verified. You can reopen them from your route library.
Reading cancelled. No routes were imported.
The app was restarted before import completed. Choose the file again to review it. Your saved routes are retained.
%1$d standalone waypoints are not imported as routes.
Already in your library — an additional copy needs confirmation.
Some selected routes are already in your library. Importing again creates separate copies and keeps the existing routes.
Import and manage your private GPX planned routes.
No planned routes yet. Import a GPX file to keep your routes here.
Use Refresh to try again or review the recovery options in the menu.
Recheck route files and recover valid unindexed routes. Existing routes and local names are retained where possible. Recovery issues will be shown.
%1$d more issues — see the menu to review all.
Route file unavailable — open details to review.
This route is unavailable or has been deleted. Return to the library to refresh.
The saved route file could not be verified: %1$s
Private planned route. Viewing or editing it does not create a workout.
Delete “%1$s” from your route library? Workout history, other routes and offline maps are retained.
Change the local display name. Original GPX metadata and route points are retained.
